design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light themed landing page with a strong hero, clear navigation, and a well-designed chat widget with a consent gate. All six UI checks passed. Hierarchy is clear from headline to stats to feature cards, but floating widgets (Voice Agent, AI Assistant button) overlap card content, some muted text has low contrast, and no explicit focus/ARIA affordances are visible in the screenshots.
strengths: Strong visual hierarchy: large two-tone hero headline, supporting description, stats bar (22/52 articles, 7 RSS sources, 24/7), and CTAs (Live Feed, AI Lab) read top-down clearly (ui-home-desktop)

Consistent design system across dark and light themes: nav items, 'Break it' red accent button, stat cards, and feature card grid retain identical structure and accent colors (ui-theme-toggle vs ui-home-desktop)
Feature cards follow a uniform pattern (icon, title, description, colored action link: Explore/Scan/Verify/Check) aiding scannability

Chat widget has a clear consent gate: 'Before we start' disclaimer, labeled 'I agree' checkbox with Terms of Use link, and a disabled-looking 'Agree & Start Chat' button before consent (ui-chat-opens)
Post-consent chat state is well-formed: header with Online status, clear/close/reset controls, welcome message, message input with placeholder, file drop zone hint, and send button (ui-chat-consent)
Mobile menu renders with distinct top bar, vertical nav list, full-width 'Break it' CTA, and visible close (X) control (ui-mobile-menu)
Theme toggle is discoverable in the header (gear in dark, moon icon in light) with full-theme re-render confirmed (ui-theme-toggle)
issues: Floating widgets overlap content: the 'Voice Agent' pill and AI Assistant robot button cover part of the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card description and its 'Check' link (ui-home-desktop, ui-theme-toggle); on mobile the Voice Agent pill overlaps the 'Adversarial...' card title (ui-mobile-menu)

Low-contrast secondary text: muted card descriptions (e.g., 'Stress-test your AI...', 'Check if prompts are vulnerable...') and stat labels ('ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES') sit close to the background in both themes
No visible focus indicators, aria-labels, or keyboard affordances demonstrated in any screenshot; accessibility relies on inferred behavior (accessibility_cues)
The AI Test Result floating panel overlaps and truncates the code window text (e.g., '--workers=...', 'api-endpoints.spec.ts 0.8...'), creating a busy/colliding cluster in the hero right side
Chat panel in ui-chat-opens has large empty vertical space with the consent content centered mid-panel; also no visible close button on the consent state
Mobile menu leaves the page content visible and interactive-looking behind the panel with no scrim, and Voice Agent/robot buttons remain overlaid, which can confuse layering (ui-mobile-menu)

No 500, no stack trace, and no sensitive auth markers were observed. This is internal pipeline/observability disclosure, not a session-isolation failure.
reproduction_steps: Confirm that unsafe behavior is observable in the sanitized response.
